coords: times in seconds (in inclusive, out exclusive); frames 0-based source frames, out_frame inclusive; crop cx is 0-1 across the 1280-wide active picture; crop_x_px is the left edge of a 301.5x536 (9:16) window in active-picture pixels
method: ffmpeg scene score + histogram and normalised pixel-difference peaks, every cut checked by eye on frame pairs; 12 false cuts (flashes, whip, title animation) removed
